tools.name: check_epub
tools.description:
Check an EPUB file (EPUB 2 or 3) against the EPUB specifications with
EPUBCheck, the W3C's conformance checker.

Input: `epub_base64` is the base64 of the EPUB, at most 4 MB decoded, or
pass the file as a download link in `file`.

Returns `summary` (`valid`, and the `fatal`, `error` and `warning`
co

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "epubcheck" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_epub · Private data: check_epub · Public sink: check_epub.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_epub · Private data: check_epub · Public sink: check_epub

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
